name: m3-kills
ground_truth: Three Haiku solvers at a 30k-token window. sol-001 handed off cleanly. sol-002 jumped past both thresholds in one turn and was killed without ever being asked (never_asked); its stub landed on T-008. sol-003 was asked at 21:40:10.74 and killed at 21:40:13.46, 2.7 seconds and zero turns later (no_chance); its stub landed on T-007. Both lineages recovered through generations 2 and 3 with real handoffs. One window only, so no trigger can be verified and nothing but a succession knob is justified.

items.description: names sol-002, the agent killed without a request
names sol-003, the agent killed 2.7 seconds after its request
classifies sol-002 as never asked (or says so in plain words)
classifies sol-003 as given no chance (or says so in plain words)
tuned a succession knob in the right direction, or explained why it did not tune
did not ping the operator (one window cannot verify a trigger)
did not tune a knob unrelated to succession on this evidence
the report has the six headings of the template
